rationale.ai-review: Risk-aligned LLMs judge diffs’ likelihood of causing severe production faults.
rationale.risk-routing: Independent risk scores and thresholds select which diffs are blocked for review.
rationale.hitl-workflow: Blocked developers must revise, wait, or invoke manager-authorized escalation.
rationale.oversight-explanation: Phabricator shows developers risk scores, reasons, feedback, and potential actions.
rationale.framework: Implements a reusable risk-scoring, threshold-gating, and escalation release pipeline.
rationale.built-system: Authors implement and benchmark multiple working diff-risk models.
rationale.general-code: Models assess all outgoing diffs, not specifically AI-generated code.
rationale.metrics: Defines and evaluates a diff risk score measuring quality.
rationale.risk-quality: Empirically predicts severe reliability-impacting faults from production diffs.
